elements_not_encoded.text: Sit patient up and if oxygen saturation < 94%, give 40% face mask oxygen at 6-8L/min.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Positioning and oxygen therapy; no manage tasks in this pass

elements_not_encoded.text: If systolic BP > 90, give furosemide 40mg slow IV. If no response after 30 minutes, give another 80mg IV. If good response, give 40mg IV after 2-4 hours.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Furosemide dosing conditional on SBP > 90; medicines not encoded

elements_not_encoded.text: If systolic BP > 90, give sublingual isosorbide dinitrate 5mg even if there is no chest pain. Repeat every 10 minutes if SBP remains >90.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Isosorbide dinitrate dosing conditional on SBP > 90; medicines not encoded

elements_not_encoded.text: If BP ≥ 180/130, give single dose enalapril 10mg orally.
